item.title: Windows POS 1.0.7+8
item.description:
Windows POS 1.0.7+8
- Detect concurrent order edits and prevent stale saves from overwriting changes made on another device. - Save changed order fields only and preserve the latest server payment total when recalculating balance. - Offer Reload after a save conflict while keeping unsaved input until reload is selected. - Includes the working counting screen improvements for order-entry error feedback and duplicate-submit protection.
Pair with Mobile Android 1.0.7+8. Cross-device physical-device acceptance testing is still pending; automated regression tests have passed.
